reply: the sine term fits best with its argument near 2 (about 2.0 to 2.15). The candidates I tried for the other two terms (logistic, exponential-in-time, power-law and 1/P forms) all left NMSE between 1e-2 and 1e-1. The best submitted candidate scored 3.6e-2, which is worse than the prior 6.2e-3 result.

def equation(t, P, params):
    return params[0]*np.sin(params[1]*np.sqrt(P)) + params[2]*P*(1-P/params[3]) + params[4]*np.exp(-params[5]*t)/P + params[6]*t**params[7]*P**params[8]
